system.description:
See Figurine of Wondrous Power

This onyx statuette of a dog can become a Mastiff for up to 6 hours. The mastiff has an Intelligence of 8 and can speak Common. It also has Blindsight with a range of 60 feet. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 7 days required before the figurine can be used again.

notes: not automated (summon): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
summon: its creature is not among the converted creatures
effect: "Mastiff Figurine" change system.traits.languages.value (add) not converted
effect: "Mastiff Figurine" change system.attributes.senses.blindsight (upgrade) not converted
